name: Player's House (565 Boylston St)
dialogue: Check the bookshelf inside for secrets before heading out on Boylston Street!

name: Oakdale Woods Trailhead
dialogue: Welcome to Oakdale Woods! Rustle the tall grass along the trail to spot lucky acorns and neighborhood coins!

name: Weeks Field
dialogue: Great job crossing safely! Weeks Field is the best shortcut on the way up to Newton Centre!

name: Rosenfeld's Bagels (Kosher Bakery)
dialogue: Fresh warm challah and sesame bagels straight out of the oven!
Take a warm paper bag for your delivery errand — careful at the Centre Street crosswalks!

name: J.P. Licks Ice Cream Shoppe
dialogue: Welcome to J.P. Licks in Newton Centre! Cookies 'n' Cream or Mint Chocolate Chip?
Here's a Double Scoop Waffle Cone for super explorer energy!

name: Newton Free Library
dialogue: You made it all the way to the Newton Free Library!
Check the outdoor pickup lockers and Little Free Library chest for rare book stamps!

name: Congregation Beth El-Atereth Israel
dialogue: Shabbat Shalom! Try Dad's Spicy Cholent for an explosive speed boost!

name: Ward Elementary Baseball Field
dialogue: Step up to the plate for batting practice or test the backyard trebuchet across the outfield!

name: The Salzberg House
dialogue: Ready for a co-op backyard hangout? Let's stop at J.P. Licks and Rosenfeld's on our way!
